source_origin: Synthetic interface chrome (icons, frames, ribbons, dice, status icons, wordmark) generated for DungeonFlux. Illustrative only; adds no gameplay requirements. Painted depictions (portraits, figures, sprites, scenes, grounds, props) were removed under the art contract (crates/df-render/src/art_contract.rs): depictions are live photographic imagery or the reviewed -documentary-photo assets listed in documentary-photo-v2.assets.json.

assets.name: wordmark

generator.tool: Codex CLI gpt-6.1-sol built-in image generation
generator.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a premium AAA fantasy game production wordmark asset matching the supplied title-screen and phone concept art. Reference images are style references only; extract the typography style, not any scene or UI. Output exactly 2048x768 PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Subject is ONLY the single word "DungeonFlux", spelled D-u-n-g-e-o-n-F-l-u-x, capital D and F. Match the title-screen logo closely: tall ornate angular fantasy serif, sharp clean engraved letterforms and tapered pointed serifs, Dungeon in burnished antique gold with warm highlights, Flux transitioning to luminous ice-blue with white icy highlights. Subtle bevel and restrained soft glow, painterly cinematic material realism with crisp typography. Single line, centered, occupy most of canvas width with clear transparent padding, whole word uncropped. No tagline, no symbols, no ornament surrounding the word, no background, no frame, no other elements, no watermark, no signature. Actual transparent pixels behind and inside letters, never a rendered checkerboard.
